title: M0 engineering foundation accepted
description: The native Swift 6 shell, public notch geometry, deterministic pointer policy, AppKit-owned panel sizing, App Sandbox, Hardened Runtime and real-hardware notch/hover acceptance formed the first accepted product foundation.

title: 0.1.0 Personal Release accepted
description: The immutable 0.1.0 Personal build was published for personal use with ad-hoc signing, App Sandbox, Hardened Runtime, checksum and provenance verification. It is intentionally not notarized.

title: Performance and public-source foundations accepted
description: P0 established target-Mac CPU/RSS/thread baselines, deterministic size budgets and event-driven resource policy. P0.1 then completed public-repository hardening without broadening runtime permissions or release authority.

title: M1 Notch Core hardening — Draft PR #10
description: Delayed hover, exactly-once public AppKit haptic feedback, pointer-monitor lifecycle, notch-adjacent chrome and deterministic panel transitions are under active development. M1 is not accepted: the Draft remains gated by deterministic tests, exact-head CI, performance/security/size checks and target-Mac interaction evidence.

title: Complete M1 interaction acceptance before feature modules
description: Close transition, reversal, Reduce Motion, multi-display and real-hardware interaction gates without weakening the security or performance baseline, then proceed to Shelf and the later productivity modules.
